name: Phantom Blood
description: The origin of the Joestar bloodline. Jonathan Joestar discovers his adopted brother Dio Brando's true nature and must fight to protect his family and loved ones.
quote: A true gentleman never stoops to the level of his opponent.

name: Battle Tendency
description: Joseph Joestar battles the Pillar Men, ancient beings who created the Stone Mask. Full of wit and cunning, Joseph uses Hamon to defeat these powerful foes.

name: Stardust Crusaders
description: Jotaro Kujo and his companions travel to Egypt to defeat DIO and save Jotaro's mother. The era of Stands begins.

name: Diamond is Unbreakable
description: In the quiet town of Morioh, Josuke Higashikata discovers a serial killer with an unusual obsession. A peaceful town hides dark secrets.
quote: Did you just say something rude about my hair?

name: Golden Wind
description: Giorno Giovanna, the son of DIO, joins the Italian mob to pursue his dream of becoming a 'Gang-Star' and eliminating the drug trade.
quote: I, Giorno Giovanna, have a dream!

name: Stone Ocean
description: Jolyne Cujoh, Jotaro's daughter, is imprisoned in Green Dolphin Street Jail and must uncover a conspiracy to alter the fabric of fate itself.

name: Steel Ball Run
description: In an alternate universe, paraplegic Johnny Joestar enters the Steel Ball Run race across America guided by the mysterious Gyro Zeppeli.
quote: I want to stand up... I want to stand up!

name: JoJolion
description: In Morioh after the 2011 earthquake, a mysterious young man with four testicles and two sets of memories must uncover his true identity.
